items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: Yeah we went to hear him there another time, and he’s confusing it. He thinks it was when we were there but we weren’t.

ctx.x: Yeah. He did a stand-up doing Shakespeare and classic stories with a sort of a southern drawl and funny angles to it. It was very good, yeah. Anyway that was—

And there were several other people. And out in the bar, after the show would be over, we would do our thing and then somebody else would do this, or comedy, whatever, a lot of things were happening. Out in the bar this wonderful, exciting piano player, Bobby Short.
Honey, I have to correct you. That isn’t true.
